author: Truckee Meadows Community College
why: A nursing student drawing up a dose from a vial in a college skills lab: the medication practice a nursing degree trains before clinical placements.
cropNote: Landscape close-up; the 16:10 centre keeps her hands, the syringe and her profile; classmates behind are blurred; the small vial label is not legible at card size.

commonsFile: Auto mechanic checking old car battery voltage.jpg
author: Shixart1985
why: Gloved hands testing a car's electrics with a meter on an open engine bay: the diagnostics work at the core of an automotive technology degree.
cropNote: Close landscape frame; the 16:10 centre keeps both hands, the tester and the engine; a tiny maker's star on the engine at the right edge is under 1% of the frame and not legible as a logo at card size.

author: Andy Dingley
why: A laser cutter tracing snowflake shapes out of wood fibreboard: the kind of FabLab making a multimedia and creative-technologies student does alongside code and 3D.
cropNote: Close, angled frame; the 16:10 centre keeps the lit cutting head and the cut shapes; no text or faces.

author: InclusiveGameLab
why: A tester in a VR headset reaching out with a controller: the immersive experiences a digital experience design student designs, builds and user-tests each semester.
cropNote: Photographed from behind; the 16:10 centre keeps the headset strap, raised hand and controller, with his reflection in the dark screen; no text or logos.

commonsFile: Gillette razor sketching Jackson Hedden industrial design.jpg
author: Jackson Hedden
why: Pencil concept sketches of a handheld product laid out beside a designer's pens: the ideation stage that starts every product in an industrial design studio.
cropNote: Landscape desk shot; the 16:10 centre keeps the sheet of product sketches and the pens along the top; no words are legible.

author: Nicolò Bertuccioli
why: A hand-built five-axis robot arm with servos, gripper and exposed microcontroller wiring: the kind of machine the AI-driven robotics track programs to act in the physical world.
cropNote: Landscape bench shot; the 16:10 centre keeps the whole arm and gripper; no people, no legible text.

author: Wentao Jiang
why: Students reading at the long oak tables of KU Leuven's central library reading room: the close reading of texts at the heart of a philosophy degree, at the university itself.
cropNote: Wide interior; the 16:10 centre keeps the tables, readers and book-lined galleries; a small monitor with a maker's mark at the bottom-right edge is under 2% of the frame and not legible at card size.

author: iurikothe from Brasilia, Brazil
why: Fine test probes positioned on a bare microchip under a lamp: hands-on embedded hardware testing of the kind an electronics-ICT degree teaches.
cropNote: Close macro; the 16:10 centre keeps the chip and the converging probe needles; no people, no legible text.

author: Dilshan Jayakody from Maharagama, Sri Lanka
why: A breadboard prototype wired to a bench power supply, with screwdriver and pliers at hand: the build-and-test work behind the embedded product engineering technology students design in their final year.
cropNote: Top-down bench view; the 16:10 centre keeps the breadboard, the wiring and the tools; no faces or legible labels.

author: U.S. Department of Agriculture
why: An ecologist standing in a river with a D-net, sampling aquatic insects to judge water quality: the fieldwork side of a sustainability degree.
cropNote: Landscape field shot; the 16:10 centre keeps her, the net and the river; a small agency emblem on her shirt is not legible at card size.

author: GlacierNPS
why: A host in headphones holding a furry-windscreen microphone while recording a podcast outdoors: the audio and content production an international communication and media student learns.
cropNote: Landscape close frame; the 16:10 centre keeps her face, headphones and microphone, with the interviewer's shoulder in the foreground; a small name badge is not legible at card size.

author: Yemi festus
why: A director leaning in to frame a shot with a camera operator on a small indoor set: the production side of film and TV that a media and entertainment business student learns to plan, fund and sell.
cropNote: Landscape frame; the 16:10 centre keeps both crew members and the camera rig; a small door sign behind them is not legible at card size.

author: BLMUtah
why: A guide with a headlamp leading a small group through a lit cave and explaining how it formed: the guided visitor experience that tourism and leisure students learn to design and run.
cropNote: Wide, warm-lit cave interior; the 16:10 centre keeps the guide, the small group and the cave ceiling; no text, no identifiable faces.
